subject: Locking an engineering-first demo window for Predicta Health
messages:
From: David Kim <david@redwood.com>
To: Samuel Ortiz <samuel@predictahealth.com>, Elena Cruz <elena.cruz@predictahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Locking an engineering-first demo window for Predicta Health

Hi Samuel / Elena —

Thanks again for a productive discovery this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we lock a technical runthrough with our infra/ML leads: 

Recap (30s):
- Goal: validate serving footprint and end-to-end latency/cost expectations for Predicta’s real-time triage use case.
- Success criteria: sub-250ms median token latency on 512-token runs, reproducible batch throughput for 20 TPS, and a plan for PII sanitization in inference path.
- Current constraints you mentioned: multi-region failover, on-prem model registry requirement, and SOC2 evidence needs.

Next step: 60–90 minute engineering-first runthrough (we call it a technical deep dive) where our infra and model-serving engineer(s) will:
1) Walk through a compact architecture tailored to your workload (15–20m)
2) Run a short live inference demo with synthetic/representative inputs (20–30m)
3) Surface recommendations (batching, caching, quant) and identify blockers (20–30m)
4) Open Q&A + next-stage mutual action items (10–15m)

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue Jun 24, 10:00–11:30
- Wed Jun 25, 14:00–15:30
- Thu Jun 26, 09:00–10:30

I attached a one-page agenda (Predicta-demo-agenda-v1.pdf) for your review. If none of these work, tell me two good blocks and I’ll coordinate with our engineers. 

Also — you mentioned a short security questionnaire. If you can send that ahead of time we’ll route it to our security/compliance lead and include preliminary answers in the prep packet.

Would you like us to invite a dedicated note-taker / CS contact so we can capture action items during the call?

Thanks,

David Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
david@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Predicta-demo-agenda-v1.pdf (1 page — proposed run order + artifact list)

From: Samuel Ortiz <samuel@predictahealth.com>
To: David Kim <david@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Cruz <elena.cruz@predictahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Locking an engineering-first demo window for Predicta Health

David —

Appreciate the clear recap and the agenda, looks great. We’re aligned on the goals. A couple quick notes: 
- We prefer the Wed Jun 25 14:00–15:30 slot (PT) if you can lock it.
- I’ll attach the security questionnaire we use (answers mostly administrative) — please have your compliance person take a look.
- Expect to have our infra lead Elena and product lead (me) on the call. We may also loop in our data privacy manager if there are SOC2 specifics.

Two asks for the runthrough:
1) Can the live demo show a short example that includes a token-level breakdown so we can see where latency is spent?
2) Please confirm if you can present a candidate quantization profile and any tradeoffs.

If you can confirm the Wed slot, I’ll block calendars and send an invite.

Thanks,
Sam
VP Product | Predicta Health
samuel@predictahealth.com | 650-555-0199

Attachment: Predicta-security-questions.docx

From: David Kim <david@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Predicta Health — availability + security questionnaire (customer asked for quant + token breakdown)

Team — forwarding Predicta thread. They picked Wed Jun 25 14:00–15:30 PT. Two specific prep asks:
1) Live demo: include a token-level breakdown visualization (latency per token / token categories) we can reproduce in ~5–10 input runs.
2) Quantization: bring the default quant profile for a 7B-class model we recommend and be ready to show the latency/quality tradeoff (ideally a quick AB-style comparison).

Who can take the demo lead and who will own the quant tradeoff slide? Also, can we have a point person to answer the security questionnaire (attached)?

Attachments from customer: Predicta-security-questions.docx
Our attachment: Predicta-demo-agenda-v1.pdf

If you can confirm owners by EOD I’ll send the calendar invite to Predicta and include the prep packet.

— David

Folks — confirmed on our side for Wed Jun 25 14:00–15:30 PT. Owners below: 
- Demo lead / infra path: Laura Bennett (I will run the live inference and token-level breakdown)
- Quant profile + tradeoffs: Monica Patel (she’ll prepare a brief AB comparison and the slide)
- Security/compliance questions: I’ll loop in our compliance lead to answer the doc; Monica, please flag any gaps we should flag to Predicta in advance.

Prep plan:
- I’ll build a 10–12 slide prep packet (architecture, expected latencies, quant summary) and share by EOD Mon Jun 23.
- Monica will include a short table that maps quant choices to expected median token latency and rough quality delta.
- David, can you create the calendar invite and include the attachments we already have (agenda + their security doc)?

Sam/Elena — thanks for the clarity on goals. We’ll aim to keep the runthrough lean and focused on measurable takeaways.

Laura Bennett
Principal Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0166
